areas.name: Environmental sustainability, adaptation and mitigation
areas.reason: Programme directly targets deforestation reduction and includes sustainability criteria in school refurbishment.

areas.name: Biodiversity and forest resources
areas.reason: Standing-forest subcomponent promotes forest and biodiversity conservation via institutional strengthening, payment for environmental services and bioeconomy.

areas.name: Individual entrepreneurs and micro/small firms
areas.reason: Fosters forest-based and bioeconomy businesses, emphasising small and community enterprises.

areas.name: Jobs and income for low-income and vulnerable groups
areas.reason: Income generation through bioeconomy is a direct income policy for vulnerable families.

areas.name: Infrastructure and social facilities for low-income and vulnerable groups
areas.reason: Invests in basic-education infrastructure and hunger-fighting facilities, bringing new social facilities to low-income populations.

areas.name: Inclusion of social minorities
areas.reason: Social minorities such as traditional and indigenous populations are the preferred target group of the whole programme.

areas.name: Education and health conditions
areas.reason: Learning-acceleration programme; education is one of the three pillars of the project.
